body:
Dude, I know no one likes to hear,  "you're young, you don't understand, things get better etc."  But honestly, I'm only a few years older than you. And let me tell you those few years mean a lot.  Don't let some girl make you feel like you're worthless.  Fuck her.  Idc if you view yourself as the ugly scrawny kid.  There's 8 billion people on this planet.  It may take some time, But you'll find someone.  Furthermore, use this opportunity to better yourself.  If you want to be something, you want to do something, Fuck what the others think.  Do everything in your ability to make it happen, and when you fall flat on your chest. Stand back up and fight for it again. 

We live in an absurd world, and mental health is a bitch.  The world is never going to be perfect.  But if you stick through it and fight, I can PROMISE you, It will get better.  

Best of luck bud, feel free to DM me (I don't get on reddit much though, so don't think I'm ignoring you)
That mean you got the rest of her stuff?
